stage1.impression: A clean, competent product still life on a concrete bar, but it reads as CG: the bar top is a flat, blotchy, cool-grey slab with soft low-resolution staining and visible slab seams, lit most brightly nearest the camera, so there is no pool of light, only an even wash. The hero tube of coloured discs is the only colour and is legible, but its base barely glows, the background speaker in its niche reads as a matte grey utility box, and the big black smoked slab at left takes a third of the frame. As a specific place it does not hold up: it is a generic bar-detail still life that a magazine would not run.

blocking_9: A visible pool of warm light centred on the request column, with the foreground bar top falling off into shadow instead of brightening toward the lens (foreground lum_median 50-70, not 85)
Concrete bar top reads as real board-formed or cast concrete at 1:1: fine aggregate, pores and sheen, warm under 2400-2700 K light, no smeared low-resolution blotches and no grid of slab seams
The request column's Smoke base visibly lit from within, so the coins glow from below and the column is the clear focal point

The left-hand record player slab no longer fills a third of the frame as an unlit black mass; the frame shows something specific about the room (counter edge, beam, record wall detail) rather than a generic tabletop
The coupe reads as a drink just poured: liquid with colour and a meniscus, rim highlight, not a black void
The background speaker reads as tinted cast acrylic with depth and glow, not a flat grey box

defects.what: Bar top brightest at the bottom of the frame (profile 68 to 94 top to bottom); even wash with no pool around the hero; cool grey (b_median 75 vs r 90)
Concrete texture smeared and low resolution at 1:1, blotchy staining, straight seams reading as a tiled grid of slabs
Column's Smoke base nearly black (lum_median 17) with only a thin bright line at the bottom; 'lit from its base' does not read
Record player slab is a large flat black-brown mass, 16% crushed, dominating the left third; the record label glows white like an emitter
Coupe holds a black, opaque-looking liquid with no colour or meniscus; heavy hard-edged black shadow disc on the napkin
Background speaker reads as matte grey plastic with an evenly lit woofer, neutral grey (r 49 g 48 b 47), no acrylic depth or glow; flat, almost daylight lighting in the niche
Frosted votive is brighter (lum_median 142) than the hero column and pulls the eye to the corner
Mixing glass and bottle dark and plain; bar spoon reads as a thin line floating against the shelves
Bottom-left corner 24% crushed: the turntable plinth goes to dead black

changes.problem: The bar top is an even wash brightening toward the lens instead of a pool of light around the column.

evidence.measured: lum_median 84.8; y profile rises 67.8 to 93.8 from top to bottom of the region

change.setting: the Domes' downlights (power and cone), aimed at the request column
change.to: 30 W, cone 16 deg, the nearest downlight aimed at the column's base (~[7.7, 4.21, 1.1])

changes.expected: A warm pool centred on the column and the coins, the foreground bar top falling to mid-shadow toward the bottom edge

changes.problem: The request column is meant to be lit from its base, but the base is nearly black and the coins are lit from outside.

evidence.measured: lum_median 16.9, only a thin highlight line (p95 184)

change.setting: the request column's base light (plain: an emitter or small area lamp inside the Smoke base, shining up the tube)
change.from: a thin glowing strip at the base's foot
change.to: a 2700 K source inside the base, about 3x current strength, so the base glows smoked-amber and light travels up through the coins

changes.expected: The base reads as a glowing smoked puck; coins brighter at the bottom, column the brightest object in the frame after the practicals

changes.problem: The concrete counter reads as a smeared, cool, tiled CG texture rather than a cast surface.

evidence.measured: blotchy soft staining at 2x crop, straight seams, b_median 75 vs r_median 90 over the counter

change.from: cool mid grey, matte, low-resolution staining with seams
change.to: a warmer grey with finer aggregate and pores at true scale, a soft satin sheen (roughness ~0.45) that picks up the downlight as a broad highlight; remove or soften the slab seams

changes.expected: Concrete warms under 2400 K light and reads at 1:1 as cast stone, with a soft specular pool under the column

changes.problem: The record player slab fills the left third as an unlit black mass and the frame says nothing specific about the room.

evidence.measured: lum_median 35, crush_pct 16.5; the slab spans x 0-520

change.to: move about 0.3 m along +x toward the column and raise to ~1.45 m, 50 mm, so the turntable is cut at the frame edge and the counter's sculpted edge, a fir beam or the record wall reads behind the column

changes.expected: Column and coupe dominate, the player is a supporting edge, more of the room's specific shell visible

changes.problem: The coupe reads as a black void, not a drink just poured.

evidence.measured: bowl contents near black at 1:1, no meniscus or rim highlight

change.setting: the coupe prop (liquid material and fill)
change.to: an amber or pale gold translucent liquid filled to ~2/3 with a meniscus and a few bubbles; soften the napkin shadow by lifting the stem foot a hair and checking the contact

changes.expected: The drink catches the downlight with a warm transmitted glow and a rim highlight

changes.problem: The niche speaker behind is flatly, evenly lit and reads as grey plastic, competing as a mid-tone instead of a glowing tinted object.

evidence.measured: lum_median 48.2, r/g/b 49/48/47, lum_range 106 with no strong highlights

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area, and the lit niche's strip
change.from: 1.0 W/m2 at the target, niche strip 6.0
change.to: 0.5 W/m2 grazing from the side, niche strip 3.0, so the cabinet is lit through its edges and the woofer falls darker

changes.expected: The background drops back and warms, the acrylic edges catch light, the hero column separates

changes.problem: The frosted votive is brighter than the hero and pulls the eye to the lower right corner.

change.setting: candle flames emission and candles point lamps
change.to: flames 40, point 1.5 W, and move the votive further from the downlight's pool

changes.expected: Votive becomes a small warm accent, under the column in brightness

changes.problem: Shadows on the left go to dead black and the record label glows like an emitter.

evidence.measured: crush_pct 23.8, lum_p5 0.2; label at ~[120, 430, 265, 465] near white

change.setting: the grade (AgX look) and the record player's label material
change.from: AgX - Medium High Contrast; label reading as self-lit
change.to: AgX - Base Contrast (or Medium Contrast) with a slight toe lift; label set to a plain matte paper, no emission

changes.expected: Shadows hold detail in the plinth, the label reads as paper lit by the room

out_of_scope.request: Give the niche Atmosphere speaker a visibly tinted, glossier cast-acrylic cabinet instead of a matte grey look
out_of_scope.why: EARF's products (shape, colour and parts) are fixed by the card; only their lighting may change

out_of_scope.request: Make the coins in the request column less multicoloured so the frame has one colour
out_of_scope.why: EARFcoins are EARF's product; their colours are fixed

out_of_scope.request: Remove or shrink the R3 Float record player in the foreground
out_of_scope.why: The record player and its placement at the decks are fixed; only the camera can reframe it
